quest.title: Business in a Marsh
quest.description: Huai'an can't stop worrying about the roaming monsters near Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever am I going to do...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: This location... It's a real challenge to run an inn here.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Dihua Marsh means lots of Silvergrass, and where treasure lies, monsters will follow.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: We're lucky that the Millelith cleared most of them out of the area. Since then it's mostly been fine.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: But inexplicably, they seem to have made something of a resurgence recently.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: I know they would never come anywhere near the inn, but there's no denying they're an eyesore. And if even I think so, I can guarantee my customers will too.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Are you free to help? It would be great if you could deal with any nearby monsters for me.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Haha... Ah, I must say I do find your forthrightness refreshing...

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Anyway. I'm not exactly thrilled to be begging a guest for help like this.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: But please be assured that you will be well compensated for your trouble.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Best of luck, and thank you.

choices.text: You're stressing out over an eyesore!?

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: Frankly, yes, their irksome presence is the biggest problem they pose.

response.speaker: Huai'an
response.text: But some people, such as a certain young gentleman obsessed with peace and quiet, find that simply intolerable. And when something upsets him, it usually ends up upsetting the rest of Dihua Marsh too...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Alright, well there's no rush. They tend to keep their distance so they don't pose a huge threat.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: But if one of the blind ones happened to lose its way and end up disrupting that young gentleman's peace and quiet...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: It might well plunge all of Dihua Marsh into a mad panic. More to the point, the inn would see no business until things finally quietened down.

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: How's it coming along? All clear?

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Fingers crossed we're in the clear for a while now...

dialogues.speaker: Huai'an
dialogues.text: Pardon? Who's the young gentleman? ...That's a question for the boss.
